serverInfo.name: provinglab
serverInfo.title: Proving Lab
serverInfo.description: Measurement datasets and reproducible methods on browser tools, OCR pipelines and AI-assisted development. Every dataset has a documented method and a control run.

tools.name: list_measurements
tools.description: List the published measurements with dataset URLs and the pages documenting how each was measured.

tools.name: get_measurement_data
tools.description: Fetch one measurement dataset as JSON, including the control run.

tools.name: get_method
tools.description: Fetch a reproducible method published as a skill.

tools.name: extract_citation
tools.description: Read the citation details a web page declares about itself and return them as a structured record plus ready-to-import RIS and BibTeX. Reports error pages and access walls instead of inventing a reference.
